item.title: United Supermarkets donates 1,000 socks to Salvation Army
item.description: United Supermarkets donated 1,000 pairs of socks to the Salvation Army on Tuesday through the Apples & Pears on a Mission initiative.

item.title: Amarillo City Council approves more affordable housing
item.description: The Amarillo City Council on Tuesday passed a second reading on four agenda items dealing with helping bring more affordable housing to Amarillo.

item.title: City of Liberal no longer accepting pennies for cash transactions starting March
item.description: The city of Liberal announced it will no longer accept pennies for cash transactions starting March 16.

item.title: Artificial intelligence contributes to spread of misinformation amid Mexican cartel violence
item.description: Violence broke out in some Mexican states after an operation by that country's government killed the head of one of the most powerful cartels. In the digital age much of the violence was seen by millions around the world on social media, but not all of it was real.

item.title: Local New Mexico advocates take rural health, Epstein concerns to Washington during the State of the Union
item.description: Two New Mexico advocates traveled to the nation’s capital during the State of the Union this week, invited by U.S. Rep. Teresa Leger Fernandez to spotlight rural health care access and accountability for survivors of human trafficking.

item.title: Amarillo College goes into further detail on independent audit
item.description: The Amarillo College Board of Regents learned more information and details regarding a forensic audit that was conducted by Weaver, a national accounting firm.

item.title: Fire warning issued Tuesday after wildfire reported in Beaver County
item.description: The National Weather Service issued a fire warning at around 11:50 a.m. on Tuesday on request by the Oklahoma Forestry Service, after reports of a wildfire three miles northeast of Beaver in Beaver County.

item.title: Wildfires cause evacuations, impact traffic across the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma, Kansas
item.description: During critically dry and high-wind conditions on Tuesday, multiple wildfires sparked across communities in portions of the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma and Kansas, causing a range of evacuations, warnings and road closures.
